result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Regular Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 3.18% (19.84% vs 16.66%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 66.8% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.97 vs benchmark 0.56, Sortino 1.21.
Defensive profile: beta 0.59 with 26% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 6.41% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.25).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -31.26% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans -18.31% to 98.14% (116.45 pp spread) — consistency score 80.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
